metadata.datasetIdentifier: Oral Pathology Multi-Class Benchmark Split (1,115 test samples)

integrityAudit.summary: Detected 464 exact duplicates (41.6% of test set) shared between train and test in the raw dataset. 584 instances have conflicting labels (e.g., identical images labeled as Calculus in train and Gingivitis in test).

scientificDisclaimer: Independent clinical evaluation performed on the stratified 80/20 test split. The automated dataset integrity audit identified 359 duplicate images across train and test partitions, with notable cross-label ambiguity between Calculus and Gingivitis. EfficientNetB0 establishes champion performance (82.51% Accuracy, 82.52% Weighted F1) combining depthwise separable convolutions and Grad-CAM spatial interpretability.
